notch.unpin: Let the panel close by itself

empty.title: Nothing to show yet
empty.body: Modules appear here as they are added.

spike.label: Muna window spike
spike.hint: Press Ctrl+Alt+M to morph, Ctrl+Alt+P to park, Ctrl+Alt+C to hide from captures.

empty.title: Nothing playing
empty.body: Play something in Spotify, a browser or another app and it appears here.

settings.preferredAppBody: Automatic follows whichever app is playing. Choosing an app keeps the notch on it while it has something to show.
settings.refreshBody: Ask Windows again for the apps that are playing, if one seems stuck.
settings.adaptiveColoursBody: Tints the strip and panel with colours from the album art.
settings.visualiserBody: Audio bars beside the art while music plays.

settings.replaceSystemFlyoutBody: Hides the Windows volume and brightness pop-up while Muna runs. If Muna stops unexpectedly, the pop-up comes back within two seconds.
settings.flyoutUnavailable: Not found yet. It appears after the first volume key press.
settings.scrollOnStripBody: What the mouse wheel does over the closed strip. Volume works there whenever the level is showing.
settings.showLevelTextBody: Shows the percentage beside the level track.
settings.muteBody: Silences the default output. Turning the volume up unmutes.
settings.micMuteBody: Mutes the default microphone for every app.
settings.brightnessBody: Each display that can be adjusted. Displays without DDC/CI are not listed.

pomodoro.title: Pomodoro
pomodoro.cycle: {{done}} of {{total}} focus phases before the long break
pomodoro.finishedAsleep: {{phase}} finished while the PC was asleep

settings.longBreakEveryBody: How many focus phases make a cycle. The break after the last one is the long one.
settings.autoStartNextBody: Breaks and focus phases follow each other without a tap. A changed length applies to the next phase that starts.

todo.title: Tasks
todo.retention_one: Deleted tasks are removed after 1 day
todo.retention_other: Deleted tasks are removed after {{count}} days
todo.empty: Type a task above and press Enter
todo.emptyBody: Add a date in words, like tomorrow 3pm, to set when it is due.
todo.trashEmptyBody_one: A task you move to the trash stays here for 1 day and can be restored.
todo.trashEmptyBody_other: A task you move to the trash stays here for {{count}} days and can be restored.

settings.retentionDaysBody: After this, tasks in the trash are removed for good.
settings.showDueInStrip: Show the next due task in the strip
settings.showDueInStripBody: Appears an hour before a timed task is due and stays 15 minutes after. All-day tasks never show.
settings.dueNotices: Announce a task when it is due
settings.dueNoticesBody: A short notice in the strip at the due time.
settings.listsBody: Tasks live in one list each. Deleting a list moves its tasks to the trash.

settings.showCpuInStripBody: A small processor gauge in the collapsed strip, refreshed every 10 seconds. Without it, nothing is measured while the panel is closed.
settings.processCountBody: The busiest processes, most CPU first. Set to none to hide the list and skip the process walk.

bluetooth.title: Bluetooth
bluetooth.radioBody: Turn the radio off to stop every device at once.

error.notFound: This device is no longer paired

empty.title: No paired devices
empty.body: Pair a device in Windows Settings and it will appear here.

off.title: Bluetooth is off
off.body: Turn it on to see your devices.

unavailable.title: Bluetooth is not available
unavailable.body: This PC has no Bluetooth radio, or Windows will not let Muna use it.

settings.lowBatteryNoticesBody: Announce a connected device in the strip when its battery reaches 20 % and again at 10 %.
settings.devicesBody: Paired devices you hide stay paired; they just leave the list.

off.title: Weather is off
off.body: Turn it on in settings to see the forecast. Muna then asks Open-Meteo for it every quarter hour.

locating.title: Finding your location
locating.body: Windows is working out where you are.

chooseCity.title: Choose a city
chooseCity.denied: Windows is not sharing your location with Muna. Pick a city in settings, or allow location for desktop apps and try again.
chooseCity.unavailable: This PC has no location source. Pick a city in settings.
chooseCity.failed: Your location could not be found just now. Muna will try again shortly.

offline.title: You seem to be offline
offline.body: The forecast will refresh when you are back online.

provider.title: The weather service is having trouble

settings.privacy: Weather is off until you turn it on. When on, Muna sends only rounded coordinates to Open-Meteo, a free forecast service with no account, and keeps the last forecast on this PC.
settings.showBody: Fetches a forecast every quarter hour while Muna runs.
settings.locationBody: Current location asks Windows once and rounds the answer to about a kilometre.
settings.noResults: No places match. Try the nearest larger town.
settings.searchOff: Turn on weather to search for a city.
settings.searchFailed: The place search is not answering; try again shortly.

settings.title: Muna settings
settings.error: Settings could not be loaded. Restart Muna and try again.
settings.saveError: Changes could not be saved. Muna is still using the previous values.

search.label: Search settings
search.emptyBody: Try another word, such as “startup”, “screen” or “colour”.

general.launchAtLoginBody: Muna starts in the background when you sign in to Windows.
general.hideFromCapturesBody: Screenshots, recordings and screen sharing leave the notch out.
general.toggleHotkeyBody: Works on the screen under the pointer. Custom shortcuts arrive with Keyboard shortcuts.
general.tourBody: The first-run steps again: screens, placement, shape and start-up.

layout.defaultsBody: Screens with their own layout in Multiple screens ignore these.
layout.shapeBody: Notch sits flush with the top edge. Island floats as a capsule.
layout.modeBody: Overlay draws over windows and steps aside for full-screen apps. Reserved keeps a band free so maximised windows start below the strip.
layout.stripHeightBody: Compact 26 px, Default 32 px, Comfortable 38 px.

position.offsetsBody: Changes apply to the notch straight away.
position.offsetXBody: From the centre of the screen. Positive moves right.
position.offsetYBody: From the top edge. Island adds its own gap.

screens.body: Each screen follows the defaults until you give it its own layout.
screens.useDefaultsBody: Turn off to give this screen its own shape, placement and offsets.
screens.enabled: Show the notch on this screen
screens.enabledBody: Off parks the notch for this screen only.
screens.emptyBody: Connect a screen and reopen settings.

appearance.accentBody: Used for toggles, the active module and the focus ring.
appearance.reduceMotionBody: Replaces springs with quick fades. Muna also follows the Windows animation effects setting.

modules.body: Switch a module off to hide it from the notch. Arrange the module bar with the arrows.
modules.emptyBody: Modules arrive with updates and appear here with their own settings.

about.openLogsBody: Log files help when reporting a problem. They never contain notification text.
about.exportBody: Saves a JSON file you can import on another PC.
about.importBody: Replaces the current settings with a file exported by Muna.
about.resetBody: Restores every setting to its default. Modules keep their data.
about.resetQuestion: Reset every setting to its default?

welcome.title: Welcome to Muna
welcome.body: A notch for Windows. Media, battery and live activities sit at the top of your screen, out of the way until you look.
welcome.steps: A few choices take a minute. Everything here can be changed later in Settings.

displays.title: Choose your screens
displays.body: The notch shows on every screen that is on here. Each screen can get its own layout later in Multiple screens.

placement.title: Choose how it sits
placement.overlayBody: Draws over windows and steps aside when a title bar sits under it.
placement.reservedBody: Keeps a band free, so maximised windows start below the strip.
placement.overlayCaption: The strip steps aside while a title bar sits under it, and comes back when it moves.
placement.reservedCaption: Maximised windows stop below the strip, at the cost of a band of screen.

shape.title: Pick a shape
shape.body: Both do the same things. Island floats a little lower, which suits browser-heavy days.
shape.notchBody: Sits flush with the top edge, like a MacBook.
shape.islandBody: Floats as a capsule with a small gap above it.

permissions.title: What Muna will ask for
permissions.body: Nothing is requested now. Each permission is asked for the first time a module needs it, and each one can be turned off again.
permissions.bluetoothBody: Battery levels of connected earbuds, keyboards and mice.
permissions.notificationsBody: Toasts in the strip and a place to triage them. Available in the Store and MSIX builds.
permissions.cameraBody: The mirror module uses the webcam only while its panel is open.

startup.title: Start with Windows
startup.body: Muna is a small tray app. Launching at login keeps the notch there whenever you sign in.
startup.launchAtLoginBody: Starts in the background when you sign in to Windows.

done.title: All set
done.body: The notch is on your screen. Rest the pointer on it to peek, click to open, and right-click for settings.
done.hint: Everything you chose lives in Settings, along with the modules and their order.
